reviews.title: good first impression
reviews.comment: Pros: They feel solid and don't sound bad. They push a good amount of air. Daisy-chainable. They come with a somewhat short extension cord with a 3 position speed switch. Cons: SHORT cords. Maybe: I've never before fought so hard to get the holes aligned to my radiator.
reviews.author: Greg

reviews.title: Great quality
reviews.comment: Very good for the price, worked great out of the box. The noise that people complained about really isn’t that bad. Took me a day of use to get used to it. Calibrating the speed in BIOS can help. The daisy chain made putting them in much easier.
reviews.author: Julius Carter

reviews.title: WOW!! Awesome airflow!
reviews.comment: Wanted a high CFM fan to pull air into an older case used as for TrueNAS. I had ordered another "high CFM" fan that was slightly less expensive, but had some quality concerns. Then I found this one, and cancelled that item. I am so glad I ran across this one as I continued to search for alternatives! Very high quality looking. Well packaged. Looks like a premium product. I had seen the pics, but didn't realize how many blades on this fan until I opened the box. I used the included inline switch to set to the HIGH setting and get maximum airflow. It pulls a ton of air into my old Antec Sonata case when installed behind the front drive bays. I can't speak to durability as I just installed, but initial impression is I am VERY satisfied with the PCCooler F5 for the money.
reviews.author: E & M's Family

reviews.title: Great cooling but loud noise level
reviews.comment: Great temperatures, keep my system cool even durying hard loads. Only complain is that the noise level can be bothersome if you want to go for a silent built (not my case tho) or live in a very quiet place
reviews.author: Johan

reviews.title: Quality Product.
reviews.comment: These fans are mf'ing amazing. Build quality is great, Functions great, Yes, as a faster running fan, it is bit more louder than the 1600rpms, but you aren't buying this for silence... I hope you guys are purchasing for performace. These are probably the cheapest 2200RPM fans I can find, I bought some on sale for half price and I bought 3 more at regular price. Thermalright does have a cheaper version but it comes with RGB lighting and I hate RGB lighting... This was the best purchase money can make for what the fan is worth. This will be as easy to install as any other 1600rpm 120mm fans you used.
reviews.author: GyungHwan Jung
